name: Monitor Workspaces
author: Vlad Boca
description: Per-monitor workspaces for multi-monitor setups: each monitor gets its own 1-9, 0, a bar badge shows which monitor has focus, Super+Tab switches monitors and Super+Ctrl+Shift+number sends a window to the other monitor. Builds on Omarchy's built-in per-monitor workspaces when present.

barWidget.description: Shows the workspaces this monitor owns as 1..9, 0, or a badge that lights up on the focused monitor.
